meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 Astropy 库帮你编写或调试天文数据分析代码,覆盖单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、表格处理、时间系统、WCS 变换和宇宙学计算等。
howto.when: 当用户编写或调试使用 Astropy 的天文数据分析代码时触发,例如涉及坐标转换、FITS 文件操作或单位换算等任务。

say.text: 把这个天体的坐标从 ICRS 转换到银道坐标。
读取 observation.fits 文件并打印头部信息和图像统计。
say.note: Claude 会用 fits.open 读取文件并分析数据。

say.text: 用 Planck18 模型计算 z=1.5 的光度距离和回溯时间。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will use the Astropy library to help you write or debug astronomical data analysis code, covering unit conversions, coordinate transformations, FITS file I/O, table handling, time systems, WCS transformations, and cosmology calculations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user is implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code that uses Astropy, such as tasks involving coordinate transformations, FITS file operations, or unit conversions.

say_en.text: Convert this object's coordinates from ICRS to Galactic.
say_en.note: Claude will use Astropy's coordinate transformation to produce code and results.

say_en.text: Read observation.fits and print the header and image statistics.
say_en.note: Claude will open the file with fits.open and analyze data.

say_en.text: Compute luminosity distance and lookback time at z=1.5 using Planck18.
say_en.note: Claude will use astropy.cosmology for the calculation.
